mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_student cs JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' AND ec.course_id = #{courseId} AND ec.status IN ('ENROLLING', 'IN_PROGRESS')

SELECT cs.class_id, c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, ec.name AS class_name, ec.teacher_id, u.real_name AS teacher_name, ec.start_date, ec.end_date, cs.enrolled_at FROM class_student cs JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = cs.class_id JOIN course c ON c.id = ec.course_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ec.teacher_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' ORDER BY cs.enrolled_at DESC, cs.id DESC
